title: Parasitic shunt (parallel) capacitance of surface-mount chip resistors: values from primary sources
scope: Capacitance across the resistor body (terminal to terminal), by package and film type, for use as the body part of the feedback-network capacitance of a 1-10 kOhm (nominal 2 kOhm) photodiode TIA feedback resistor. Pad and layout capacitance are outside this file except where a source cannot separate them.

conventions.pdf_page: Page index as a PDF viewer counts it (1-based), not the printed page number.
conventions.C_fF: Single value in femtofarads when the source gives one number; C_fF_range gives [min, max] when a range applies.
conventions.value_type: One of: fitted model coefficient (from measured S-parameters or impedance), measured, simulated, stated typical, derived in this survey (computed here from a plotted curve; the source does not state the number).
conventions.verification: read_on_rendered_page = number read by eye on the rendered PDF page or image; derived_from_vector_curve = computed here from the vector path of a plotted curve; derived_from_raster_curve = computed here from a bitmap curve; confirmed_on_publisher_page = also checked against the publisher's HTML.
conventions.C_eq_definition: For derived records, C_eq(f) = sqrt((R/|Z|)^2 - 1) / (2 pi f R), i.e. the capacitance a pure parallel R-C would need to give the plotted |Z|/R at frequency f. The median and spread over the points with 0.15 < |Z|/R < 0.95 are reported. Point data: data/parasitic_cf/resistor_curve_readings.csv.

records.source_title: Frequency Response of Thin Film Chip Resistors (Technical Note)
records.publisher: Vishay Intertechnology (Vishay Thin Film); measurements and modelling by Modelithics
records.figure_or_table: Table 1 (model internal coefficients); model topology Fig. 3 on p. 2
records.package: 0201 (0.51 mm x 0.25 mm as listed in Table 1)
records.film_type: thin film, PVD NiCr on 99.5 % alumina, balanced edge-sense trim
records.product: Vishay Thin Film FC-type flip-chip resistors
records.nominal_resistance_ohm: 50 to 1000 (Table 1 gives the average over part values)
records.external_elements: Cg (to ground, each end) about 7-9 fF and Lc about 0.025-0.035 nH for 0201 (Fig. 7, p. 3, read by eye); at 1000 ohm Cg about 8 fF, Lc about 0.035 nH
records.value_type: fitted model coefficient (internal shunt capacitance C) from measured S-parameters
records.included: Resistor body only: the model separates Cg and Lc, and the chip contact pads are included in a transmission-line model of the test-board mounting pads, so C is the internal terminal-to-terminal capacitance. Part mounted on a quartz microstrip board with the RF ground plane on the reverse side.
records.instrument_fixture: S-parameters on quartz microstrip test boards (Modelithics)
records.resistance_dependence: Source, p. 3: the internal coefficients do not depend strongly on size or part value; Table 1 lists averages. External Cg roughly constant, Lc rises with part value (Fig. 7).
records.mounting_dependence: Cg and Lc depend on mounting; wrap-around parts sit further from the ground plane than flip chips on these boards (p. 4).
records.how_read: Table 1 read on the rendered page (160 dpi).

records.source_title: Estimating the Parasitics of Passive Circuit Components (EMC Concepts Explained column)
records.publisher: B. Adamczyk, N. Koeller, M. Healy; In Compliance Magazine, April 2022
records.figure_or_table: Table 1 (resistor parasitic capacitance), Figure 4 (impedance curves), Equation 2
records.package: not stated (resistor on a small SMA test board; photo suggests 0603 or 0805)
records.value_type: measured: C = 1/(2 pi f R) at the -3 dB frequency of |Z| (833.5 MHz)
records.included: Resistor on a PCB, one-port VNA measurement; open/short/load standards on the same board at the same trace length, so connectors and traces are removed; pad capacitance is included to the extent the open standard does not remove it.
records.resistance_dependence: The same article gives 0.276 pF for 300 ohm (-3 dB at 1.921 GHz) and 0.225 pF for 31.6 kOhm (-3 dB at 22.36 MHz); the spread reflects the limits of the -3 dB method and of one-port VNA measurement far from 50 ohm, not a real R dependence (the authors say the approach does not target accuracy).
records.how_read: Table 1 and Figure 4 read on the downloaded images.

records.source_title: High frequency modeling of SMD resistors: Creating 3D and equivalent circuit models to capture the parasitics of SMD resistors up to 42 GHz (Master's thesis)
records.publisher: J. Andersson, M. Fahd; Chalmers University of Technology, Department of Microtechnology and Nanoscience, 2024
records.figure_or_table: Section 4.2.1.1 (Cp, L, Cg); substrate scaling Fig. 4.18 on PDF p. 63 (printed 47); Cp(R) Fig. 4.15 on PDF p. 59 (printed 43)
records.external_elements: Cg = 39 fF; Ctml = 38 fF, Ltml = 54 pH (pad line sections)
records.value_type: simulated (Ansys HFSS 3D model, parameters extracted at 42 GHz)
records.included: Terminal-to-terminal Cp of a modelled resistor on a microstrip board (substrate height and permittivity per Table 3.1, about 0.1 mm, er 3.66), separate from Cg to ground.
records.resistance_dependence: Scalable model: Cp falls from about 10.6 to 3.2 fF as R rises from 43 to 111 ohm (Fig. 4.15), an artefact of extracting at 42 GHz where the series inductance dominates; not applicable to kOhm values.
records.mounting_dependence: Fig. 4.18 (simulated, er = 3): raising the substrate height from 4.68 to 13 mil raises Cp from about 9.2 to 10.0 fF and lowers Cg from about 34.5 to 24.7 fF.
records.how_read: Read on rendered pages (110 dpi).
